newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds closed firmer but off session highs on Thursday and dealers saw very few domestic factors driving the market.
"It has been a technical day, with prices moving in a very narrow range," a dealer in Madrid said. "That's because we saw prices moving within technical ranges".

The Meff future contract closed at 107.08. Chart analysts predicted resistance at 107.40 and support at 107.00, then at 106.90. "We don't think the market will move away from these two levels," a dealer in Madrid said. The 10-year spread over German Bunds slimmed to 178 basis points from 180.
The three year 7.80 percent bond closed higher at 102.80 percent from 102.78, yielding 6.72 percent.
